title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Karachi Begum. Tip #1
body: She has a WhatsApp group of fourteen women running since 2011 that has arranged more marriages than any professional in this city. Ask how she knows somebody and it involves a school, a cousin, and a funeral in 2004. It's a sealed deal if she can place any Karachi surname in four seconds and tell you which branch and whether they're the good ones.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 the kitty group is the real power structure.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Karachi Begum. Tip #3

The same man off Tariq Road for seventeen years, knows her measurements without asking, raised his prices and nobody argued because there is no alternative. It's a sealed deal if a wedding outfit was delayed a month rather than handed to somebody new.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Karachi Begum. Tip #5
body: Watch the charity, because it is real work and also a ladder. A school, a clinic, a trust, a winter fundraiser at the Movenpick that costs more to stage than it raises. She works genuinely hard at it. It's also the only board she will ever sit on and she knows it. It's a sealed deal if the fundraiser has been the same weekend for eleven years.

body: Ask about her children and count the seconds before abroad comes up. Both in Toronto or London. Mentioned lightly and constantly. She has not properly seen them in over a year and discusses that with nobody. It's a sealed deal if her lock screen is from a graduation she flew fourteen hours to attend.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Karachi Begum. Tip #8
body: Ask about the staff and the whole class reveals itself. She knows the cook's daughter's result. She paid for a wedding. She has also never once considered the arrangement strange. Both are true and neither has been examined. It's a sealed deal if someone has worked in that house thirty years and is called family in a sentence that also contains an instruction.
